name: 92260 · Palm Desert, CA
findings: ZIP 92260 (Palm Desert) has 161 nonprofit organizations. 75 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 55 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92260 (Palm Desert) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92260 (Palm Desert) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 47 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
